name: foundation
description: Foundation — canonical AWS monorepo starter: Serverless Python 3.12 lambdas + shared Lambda layer + Terraform (RDS/Cognito/S3) + Amplify-hosted frontend
//: Root has no runtime dependencies. serverless-prune-plugin (and any other serverless plugin) lives per-service in that service's own package.json. Prefer the global serverless CLI (v3) over npx — npx may resolve a different version. The project-name placeholders in the deploy: scripts are renamed by scripts/scaffold-project.sh.

scripts.deploy:service: cd services/weddings-service && npx serverless deploy --stage dev
